The uses stated sit in education, agriculture and health targeting, which are the sectoral study's.

facts.fact: Tuko reports President Ruto told a New York roundtable that legislation to regulate AI use in education and other sectors such as agriculture was already underway in Parliament.
facts.system: AI legislation said to be before Parliament

facts.fact: Tuko reports President Ruto said the government uses AI to give algorithms on each parent's financial status for the means-testing instrument that distributes education funding.
Tuko reports President Ruto said Kenya uses AI for education-funding means testing, for distributing fertiliser to farmers and for identifying universal health coverage beneficiaries.

KEN.note: No AI model, dataset or computing built in Kenya is stated.
